To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, logan_wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@crescentlabs.com>
Cc: Crescent Labs Procurement <procurement@crescentlabs.com>
Date: 2028-07-12T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Node pledge validation + fleet snapshot for Crescent Labs (final technical check)

Team / Maria —

We're at the finish line on the Crescent Labs commitment. Before we finalize the reserved capacity terms (4-week guaranteed node pledge + 2-week transition buffer), Ops asked for a quick verification of the exact node types and a micro-snapshot of available GPU counts in the target region.

Key asks:  
- Karthik: confirm the per-node memory / vram requirement from the attached runbook and whether 80% packing is realistic for their workload.  
- Neha / Logan: can you provide an availability snapshot for US region (NVidia A100 / H100 equivalents) covering the proposed window 2028-08-01 to 2028-09-01 and indicate if a short soft-lock (48h hold) is feasible while we get PO?
- Maria: if you can confirm target concurrency (avg tokens/sec per session) we can size the final node count.

Attachment: [attachment: node_requirements_v2.xlsx (xlsx, 34 KB)]

Prefer quick replies — trying to push the final commitment this week.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com
From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, logan_wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@crescentlabs.com>
Date: 2028-07-12T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Node pledge validation + fleet snapshot for Crescent Labs (final technical check)

Aditya / team —

Quick technical readout after a first pass on node_requirements_v2.xlsx:  
- The baseline model footprint Maria flagged maps to ~40 GB KV + 10 GB activations at the 2k token steer; H100-80GB equiv nodes would be the cleanest fit for latency targets.  
- At 80% packing we're looking at ~6 concurrent sessions per node under current prompt patterns, 10/session peak possible with short bursts.  
- If Crescent expects steady-state >35 concurrent sessions, recommend adding a 10-15% buffer for headroom.

Question for Maria: are you planning any long-context evals (8k+) in the first 2 weeks post-launch? That materially changes readahead and KV sizing.

Happy to sync on a short call if you want to walk through the spreadsheet.

—Karthik
Principal Infra Architect | Redwood Inference
From: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, logan_wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@crescentlabs.com>
Date: 2028-07-14T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Node pledge validation + fleet snapshot for Crescent Labs (final technical check)

Aditya / Karthik / Maria —

Attached is the fleet snapshot for US region covering H100/80GB and A100/80GB equivalents for the 2028-08-01 to 2028-09-01 window. We took inventory across reserved, committed, and best-effort pools. Summary below:  
- H100-80GB equivalents: 42 nodes available in reserved pools (can be earmarked).  
- A100-80GB equivalents: 18 nodes available with 72% packable capacity.  
- Short soft-lock (48 hours) to hold ~12 H100 nodes while procurement completes is feasible; operationally we require a signed commitment to convert the soft-lock to a reserved pledge within 72 hours of the hold release.

Attachment: [attachment: fleet_snapshot_q3.pdf (pdf, 88 KB)]

If sizing is 6-8 concurrent sessions/node as Karthik suggests, the 12-node soft-lock covers an initial launch of ~70 concurrent sessions (with conservative headroom). If Crescent confirms higher concurrency or long-context runs we should scale to 14–16 nodes.

Logan: forwarding the placement constraints we discussed offline — cross-AZ preference + customer-managed KMS key (they asked for CMEK).

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Capacity Planner | Redwood Inference
From: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@crescentlabs.com>, Crescent Labs Procurement <procurement@crescentlabs.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, logan_wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-16T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Crescent Labs: proposed node pledge and next steps (PO request)

Maria / Procurement team —

Thanks for the quick responses. Based on Karthik's sizing and Neha's availability check, our suggested starting commitment is:  
- 12 H100-80GB equivalent nodes (soft-lock for 48 hours) covering launch week, with option to expand to 16 nodes if you confirm sustained concurrency >70 sessions.  
- 4-week reserved commitment period (2028-08-01 through 2028-08-29) with a 2-week transition buffer.

Requested next steps:  
1) Procurement: Can you issue a PO that references deal CL-2028-07-19-001 and lists the 12-node starting pledge? We can hold the soft-lock once PO is received.  
2) Maria: confirm whether you expect any 8k+ evaluation runs in week 1. If yes, we recommend increasing to 14 nodes upfront.  

If we get PO by end of day 2028-07-19 we can hold the 12-node soft-lock starting 2028-07-20 and start configuration with CMEK.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — happy to hop on a 15-min call to finalize.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: (555) 867-1200
From: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@crescentlabs.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Crescent Labs Procurement <procurement@crescentlabs.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, logan_wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-19T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Crescent Labs: proposed node pledge and next steps (PO request)

Thanks — we are aligned. Procurement will route a PO this afternoon referencing CL-2028-07-19-001 that covers the 12-node starting pledge.

To confirm on workload: we do have one internal long-context test (8k) in the first 72 hours; please size for that and add two extra nodes if possible (so target 14 nodes). Can you set the soft-lock for 72 hours instead of 48 while procurement signs? If that's not operationally possible, we will expedite the PO.

Maria Gomez
Head of Platform Engineering | Crescent Labs
maria.gomez@crescentlabs.com
